history.summary: Shri Jalaram Mandir at Shastri Street, Mathiya Chora, in Anand town, dedicated to Jalaram Bapa (1799-1881), the Lohana saint of Virpur (Rajkot district) famed for his lifelong sadavrat (free feeding of sadhus and the needy). The founding/consecration date of this Anand temple was not found in any source — UNVERIFIED. It is a separate, smaller shrine from the much larger and better-known Jalaram Tirth at Dharmaj (built 1978, ~20 km away in Anand district), which should not be confused with it. Darshan hours 6:00 AM-8:00 PM per local listings.

name: Jalaram Temple, Anand
town_description: Anand is a city in central Gujarat known as the Milk Capital of India, home of Amul and the birthplace of India's White Revolution. It is a major rail junction on the Mumbai-Ahmedabad line and adjoins the Vallabh Vidyanagar educational hub. The old-town area of Mathiya Chora, where this temple stands, hosts several traditional shrines.
